horizons.name: Horizon 0 — Quick Wins
horizons.theme: Compress clicks, automate the obvious, instrument everything
items: Omnichannel reminder cascade: ZNS → SMS → automated voice call, delivery-status driven (FB-041)
Geofenced auto check-in/out + signature capture in the PWA — the EVV foundation (FA area: mobile)
Exception-only visit completion: auto-verify untouched quotes, one-sheet complete (W-007/W-008)
Nightly batch Red Invoice submission with retry queue (W-016/W-017)
Timecards auto-filled from PWA GPS check-in/out; only mismatches surface (W-040)
Post-visit family snapshot via Zalo ZNS (FA-066) and no-login live-ETA link (UX-093)
Glove mode + sunlight theme for the nurse PWA (UX-081/083)
Structured vitals v1: coded model behind the existing free-text field, trending charts in biz_bi
Instant first-visit offer at lead qualification — 3 feasible slots as one-tap ZNS accept (W-026)
horizons.outcome: Visible relief for nurses, dispatchers and finance inside one quarter; data foundations (vitals, EVV events) laid for everything that follows.

horizons.name: Horizon 1 — Clinical Spine
horizons.theme: Become a clinical platform, not just an operations platform — and beat the Vietnam EMR deadline
items: health_careplan: goals, interventions, review cycles — compiled into per-visit PWA task checklists
health_vitals: LOINC-coded observations, per-client Blockly alert thresholds (FA-005)
health_emar: medication orders + administration records with refusal reasons
health_forms: configurable assessment/forms engine on the VU form engine (pain, ADL, nutrition, cognition)
health_incident: adverse-event capture, investigation workflow, register
health_consent: consent capture at intake + check_consent() cross-cutting layer
EVV verification chain: hash-linked GPS + geofence + signature + task attestations (FA-052)
health_api_gateway v1: OpenAPI, API keys/OAuth2, /api/v1 wrapping the PWA controller
Read-only FHIR R4 facade over existing models (Patient, Encounter, Observation, DocumentReference)
VNeID identifier slots + MOH EMR export pack — Circular 13/2025 readiness before the 31 Dec 2026 facility deadline
horizons.outcome: Care plans, vitals, meds, incidents and consent close the gap to AlayaCare/WellSky table stakes; Vietnam regulatory position secured ahead of the market.

horizons.name: Horizon 2 — Experience & Expansion
horizons.theme: Win families, win referrers, enter new markets
items: health_portal_family + Zalo Mini App: care visibility, visit stories, bill pay, kinship-aware permissions (FB-003/FB-013)
health_messaging: secure in-app client messaging + broadcast + auto-triaged Zalo inbox (UX-061)
Online self-booking against FHIR Slot/Schedule (clinic services first)
health_telehealth: video micro-consults attached to bookings
health_routes: learned motorbike travel-time matrices from PWA GPS history → route-optimized assignment (AI-022)
Ambient scribe v1: Vietnamese ASR (PhoWhisper) + LLM structured notes, offline-capable, nurse-confirmed (AI-001/AI-002)
health_fhir_gateway: country adapters — SATUSEHAT conformance (Indonesia) as first external proof, NEHR (Singapore) scoped
health_claims: NDIS/My Aged Care funding budgets + claim scrubbing for Australia entry
Margin-per-visit engine live in biz_bi (FB-062)
AI gateway: PHI redaction, cloud/local model routing, per-feature budgets (AI-058)
horizons.outcome: Family experience becomes a sales weapon; ambient documentation matches WellSky/Dragon in a language they don't serve; first non-Vietnam market entered through FHIR conformance.

horizons.name: Horizon 3 — Intelligence Moats
items: Client health digital twin + honest trajectory view for families (IF-001/IF-032)
Operations twin: what-if simulator for demand, staffing and coverage (IF-002)
health_telemonitoring at scale: wearables/IoT ingestion as FHIR Observations, device fleet dashboard
Blockly automation studio: no-code event→condition→action across the whole platform (FB-110)
Clinical pathway builder: Blockly-composed PlanDefinitions with outcome tracking (IF-004)
Zero-data-entry visit: ambient voice + camera verification + sensor fusion compose the record; nurse just confirms (IF-031)
Predictive staffing and burnout radar feeding the roster (AI bank workforce cluster)
Outcome benchmarking network across providers (anonymized, opt-in) (IF bank)
Value-based contract engine: outcome-linked pricing on the Blockly paradigm (IF-022)
horizons.outcome: Proprietary data (travel matrices, outcomes, twins) + no-code operations = a defensible platform, not a feature list.

principles: Every horizon ships nurse-visible relief, not just infrastructure.
New clinical models are born-FHIR — schema designed from the resource inward.
AI features route through one governed gateway; local-model (Ollama) fallback wherever PHI residency demands.
Extend proven paradigms (Blockly, offline sync, workspace shells) instead of inventing new ones.
Regulatory deadlines are roadmap anchors: VN Circular 13/2025 (Dec 2026), AU Support at Home, SATUSEHAT conformance.
